sn13.5:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso mahāpaṭhaviyā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya.
sn13.5:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā yā vā mahāpaṭhavīti?
sn13.5:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittāti.
